dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: Good morning. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Quisiera un billete de ida y vuelta a la capital, por favor.
dialogue.en: I would like a return ticket to the capital, please.

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.text: Claro. El próximo tren sale a las nueve, desde el andén cuatro.
dialogue.en: Of course. The next train leaves at nine o'clock from platform four.

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.text: Sí, va a la hora. Pero tiene que cambiar de tren en la ciudad siguiente.
dialogue.en: Yes, it is on time. But you must change trains in the next city.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: I understand. How much is the ticket?
